shortDescription: UPCISB UP Cooperative Bank various post new exam date 2026. Candidates should check the official portal for the latest schedule and admit card.
content:
The new examination date for various posts under UP Cooperative Bank / UPCISB recruitment has been announced or updated.

Candidates who applied should check the official board / bank recruitment website for the latest exam schedule, admit card link and instructions. Verify the date, shift, reporting time and venue before attending.

How to check the new exam date

  1. Open the official UPCISB website
  2. Find the UP Cooperative Bank new exam date notice
  3. Enter registration details if requested
  4. Download the latest notice or admit card
  5. Carry a printed admit card and valid photo ID
